svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: From the agent’s effort to yours
svg.desc: Two brags side by side. Today: my agent did it in 10 million tokens, drawn as a long stream of token marks. Next: I did it in 10 keystrokes, drawn as ten keycaps such as Tab, A and R.
svg.text: From the agent’s effort to yours
Effort counted on the agent’s side.
